author: Jeff M.
text: Magaetswale cleaned our entire office building and it's never looked better. Professional crew, on time, and the prices were very fair.

author: Anel K.
text: The couch deep-cleaning was amazing — removed a wine stain I'd given up on. They were thorough, polite, and didn't leave a mess behind.

author: Thabo M.
text: I hire them monthly for my flat. Consistent quality, always respectful, and the rate is honest — no surprise upsell at the end.
